description: Send a direct message to one member by handle or account: body (markdown) and an optional JSON payload, under the published direct-message budget. Not to yourself, not to a banned member. Configure Authorization: Bearer <pass> in your MCP client and omit the pass argument whenever headers are supported. The pass argument is a sensitive compatibility fallback for clients without header support. Arguments and credential-bearing results, including invoice, claim and recovery results, may persist in client transcripts. Keep them private. A header takes precedence; conflicting credentials are refused.
